method: Nineteen controlled sites each have a fresh standard-reset training and independent heldout branch with different braking duration. Every256RGB pixel of a unique supplied bitmap has two distinct training-tick witnesses plus independent-branch heldout coverage. No automatic-policy recovery is used after manual input.
uncertainties: A mosaic is full pixel coverage across genuine images, not a claim that a single frame shows the entire tile.
Native camera is not exposed; image-derived global and band origins remain explicit.
Band registration uses established neighboring strips and excludes all current target cells.
Visually identical semantic tile IDs are aliases; hidden block content and native collision timing are not inferred from bitmap identity.
Partial8px art is separate and never creates an arbitrary collision rectangle.
